definitions.explanation: one of the cardinal or intercardinal directions (north, south, east, west, etc.)
the direction a building or room faces, important in Japanese real estate

examples.japanese: この{方角|ほうがく}に{行|い}けば{駅|えき}がある。
examples.english: If you go in this direction, you'll find the station.

examples.japanese: {方角|ほうがく}が{分|わ}からなくなった。
examples.english: I lost my sense of direction.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}は{南向|みなみむ}きの{方角|ほうがく}だ。
{物件|ぶっけん}を{選|えら}ぶとき、{方角|ほうがく}は{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: The orientation is important when choosing a property.

notes:
{方角|ほうがく} refers specifically to compass directions (north, south, east, west) and the orientation of buildings. It is more specific than {方向|ほうこう}, which means direction in a general sense.

CARDINAL DIRECTIONS:
- {東|ひがし}: east
- {西|にし}: west
- {南|みなみ}: south
- {北|きた}: north

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {方角|ほうがく}が{分|わ}からない: to not know which direction
- {南向|みなみむ}きの{方角|ほうがく}: south-facing orientation
- {方角|ほうがく}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the direction

REAL ESTATE USAGE:
In Japanese property listings, {方角|ほうがく} is a standard item. {南向|みなみむ}き (south-facing) is the most desirable orientation because rooms get the most sunlight throughout the day.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {方角|ほうがく}: compass direction, orientation (specific to N/S/E/W)
- {方向|ほうこう}: direction (general — "which way")
- {方位|ほうい}: compass bearing (more technical/precise)
- {向|む}き: facing, orientation (practical — {南向|みなみむ}き)
